data.name: Lorencia
data.gender_notes: Lorencia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Laurus', meaning laurel, a tree often used as a symbol of triumph and victory in ancient Rome. In Christianity, the name Lorencia is associated with Saint Lorencia, a Christian martyr who is said to have been crowned with laurel wreaths before her execution. The name Lorencia carries the meaning “Laurel wreath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lorencia usually hope their child will grow to embody laurel wreath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph, victory, and the rewards of spiritual dedication.
data.etymology: Lorencia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Laurel wreath.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lorencia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: לורנציה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לורנציה היא שם שמקורו בלטינית, ומשמעותו 'חסידות'. השם נקשר לעקדה, שהייתה אשה ישראלית, והייתה ידועה בחסדה ובנאמנות. השם הפך לפופולרי בעקבותיו פעל, שהיה בן דודו של ישו. במסורת הנוצרית, השם 'לורנציה' מסמל חסידות, תקווה וקדושה.

in_greek.name: Λορεντία
in_greek.long_meaning: Λορεντία είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από την Λατινική, με σημασία την 'Ελπίδα'. Η λέξη συνδέεται με την Ακηδία, μια γυναίκα της Εβραϊκής Βίβλου, η οποία ήταν γνωστή για την ελπίδα της, την χάρη της και την αθανασία της. Το όνομα έγινε δημοφιλές λόγω του προηγουμένου του, ο οποίος ήταν εγγονός του βαπτιστή. Στη Νεοελληνική Βίβλο, το όνομα 'Λορεντία' σημαίνει ελπίδα, χάρη, αγάπη και αθάνατο.

in_latin.name: Lorencia
in_latin.long_meaning: Lorencia est nomen quod a Latina provenit, significans 'Fides'. Nomen hunc connectamus cum Acedia, quae in Biblia Veteri mentionatur, quae fuit nota sua fide, gratia, et immortalitate. Nomen hanc populare fecit predecessor eius, qui erat nepos Ioannis Baptistae. In Ecclesia Catholica, nomen 'Lorencia' significat fidem, gratiam, fidem, sanctitatem, et immortalitatem.

in_english.name: Lorencia
in_english.long_meaning: Lorencia is a name derived from Latin, meaning 'Hope'. The name is connected to Acedia, a woman mentioned in the Old Testament, who was known for her hope, charity, and immortality. The name became popular due to her predecessor, who was the nephew of John the Baptist. In the Christian tradition, the name 'Lorencia' symbolizes hope, charity, faithfulness, holiness, and immortality.

historical_references.reference: Lorencia of the Thebaid, also known as Saint Lorentia or Saint Laurence of Thebes, is believed to be a martyr who lived during the 3rd or 4th century. She is said to have been born in Egypt and was the daughter of a pagan nobleman. According to legend, she was converted to Christianity by Saint Anthony the Great, who was her uncle. After her father's death, she renounced her inheritance and gave it to the poor. She was arrested for her faith and, during her imprisonment, was subjected to various tortures including having her breasts cut off. Miraculously, they grew back whole. She was eventually beheaded and her body was taken to Constantinople and buried in the Church of the Holy Apostles.

Another Saint Lorencia, also known as Saint Ursula and her 11,000 Virgins, is a legendary figure of early Christian martyrdom. The story dates back to the late 4th or early 5th century and is rooted in the cult of Saint Ursula, a British princess. According to legend, Ursula and her companions were on their way to Rome to marry a pagan prince when they were ambushed and killed by the Huns. Each virgin was given three blows before being beheaded, and Ursula herself received a total of 11 wounds before she died. The name Lorencia is sometimes associated with this legend, as it is said that she was one of the virgins in Ursula's retinue.

In the Latinx community, it represents a connection to their roots and heritage, as part of a larger trend towards the recognition and celebration of diverse Latin identities. Lorencia is also seen as a symbol of multiculturalism and inclusivity, reflecting the growing importance of acknowledging and embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences. Furthermore, the name Lorencia has gained significance within the feminist movement, as it embodies the power and grace of strong, independent women. Lorencia is a popular name on social media platforms, where it is used as a hashtag and in personal profiles to express identity and pride. In literature, Lorencia is a common character name in works that explore Latinx identity and feminist themes. In film and TV, Lorencia is a name given to characters that challenge traditional gender roles and stereotypes, empowering young girls and women to embrace their unique identities and strengths.
